scope_statement: Apply the framework empirically to a selected platform using only publicly available data and documents.
must_cover: Platform short profile and relevant user group delineation
Define market boundaries relevant to framework application
Identify direct and indirect network effects, both positive and negative
Assess relation between network effects and user/provider growth and critical mass
Observe multi-homing prevalence and switching costs
Analyze governance changes and links to quality indicators
Describe pricing, fees, commissions, and notable fee changes
Discuss competition using available market-share indicators
should_cover: Cite and list public data sources and document types
Report timeframe, data periods, and key metrics used
Use visualizations for growth and market-share trajectories
Note limitations, biases, and data quality concerns
Cross-validate findings across multiple public sources
must_avoid: Introducing new theory beyond the framework
Use of confidential or proprietary-only sources
Platform endorsement, advocacy, or policy prescriptions
main_query: empirical platform case study network effects governance fees market share public data
facet_queries: market share indicators and competitive dynamics
case synthesis strategy and regulation implications
scoring_guidance: Prioritize sources with empirical case studies using public data, clear methodology, explicit mapping to framework dimensions, and measurable metrics. Score higher for credibility, recency, and cross-validated evidence. Penalize theoretical-only, speculative, or proprietary-confidential-only sources.
